description: VibeASR.cpp's CPU-first VibeVoice ASR port: an INT8 (I8_S) audio VAE encoder feeding a ternary (I2_S) Qwen2 decoder, ported to audio.cpp.

request.name: output_format
request.description: Prompt suffix asked of the decoder: plain transcription text, or JSON rows with Start/End/Speaker/Content.

request.name: context
request.description: Extra context injected into the prompt (names, jargon) to bias the transcription.

request.name: max_new_tokens
request.description: Cap on decoded tokens for one request.

session.name: encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: VAE encoder graph arena size in MB.

session.name: prefill_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Decoder prefill graph arena size in MB.

session.name: decode_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Decoder single-step graph arena size in MB.

packages.description: Upstream VibeASR.cpp GGUF package. The two GGUFs carry the VibeASR ggml fork's type ids and need one pass of tools/community_models/convert_vibeasr_gguf.py --in-place before audio.cpp can load them.

ui.summary: INT8 encoder plus ternary Qwen2 decoder transcription on CPU.
